title: Grilled Flank Steak with Chimichurri
seoTitle: Grilled Flank Steak with Chimichurri | Firefighter Meal
subtitle: Bright herbs, charred beef
description: Bright herbs, charred beef. Sized for a full crew, with timing that still works when the kitchen gets interrupted.

steps.title: Blend chimichurri
steps.instruction: Pulse parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper flakes until saucy but not puréed. Rest 20 minutes at room temp so vinegar mellows.

steps.title: Season the flank
steps.instruction: Pat steak dry; salt aggressively 30 minutes ahead. Grill over high heat 450°F when ready.

steps.title: Grill and rest
steps.instruction: Grill 4–5 minutes per side to 125–130°F. Rest 8 minutes — carryover hits medium-rare. Slice thin against the grain.

steps.title: Dress and serve
steps.instruction: Spoon chimichurri over sliced steak; serve extra sauce on the line. Hold steak loosely tented — saucing too early washes away crust.

proTips: Keep a backup tray warm in the oven for late calls — nothing worse than cold plates after a run.
Taste for salt at the end — hall palates run salty after long shifts.
Rest grilled proteins 5–8 minutes under foil before slicing — juices stay in the meat.

Slice proteins on a cutting board at the end of the line so everyone sees the smoke ring and char.

leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
